controls.name: released_rlt_a
controls.description: Unmodified published encoder and actor, deterministic evaluation

initialization.critic_reason: Do not automatically inherit value estimates from the old training implementation
initialization.bc_calibration: Supervise actor on base VLA actions from training rollouts; save a BC-only control before RL

single_gpu_start.gpu_budget_basis: Local inference peak approximately 9.35 GiB reserved, plus training modules, replay minibatches and rendering; exact training peak remains unmeasured
single_gpu_start.external_gpu_jobs: preserve; reduce batch or postpone if available memory is insufficient

shared_candidate_parameters.buffer_warmup_transitions: Warmup one baseline episode per task; require at least two transitions for updates; record actual batch sizes.
shared_candidate_parameters.remarks: Conservative pilot starting hypotheses, not verified optimal; smoke disables pretraining and limits BC to two steps. Fixed update count replaces upstream UTD scheduling. Record actual balanced batch sizes.

budgets.smoke: 1 training initial state; establish nonzero Actor and Critic updates, real new environment transitions, finite losses, checkpoint reload and correct split
budgets.pilot: First 200 new training episodes per candidate in a declared task scope, including data collection for warmup; checkpoint every 50 episodes
budgets.extend_only_if: correctness checks pass, validation signal is useful, and actual interaction cost is measured

decision_rule.validation_selection: Highest 10-task macro success; ties use fewer paired regressions, then fewer steps on jointly successful episodes; base VLA remains a valid deployment choice
decision_rule.paired_win: optimized succeeds and base fails on identical task, initial state and evaluation seed
decision_rule.paired_loss: base succeeds and optimized fails on identical task, initial state and evaluation seed
decision_rule.uncertainty: Report paired success-rate difference with task-stratified bootstrap interval and exact McNemar/binomial discordant-pair test; state the fixed-task/finite-state sampling limitation
decision_rule.stronger_evidence: Positive locked-test difference with an uncertainty interval excluding zero and consistent independent-training-seed results
decision_rule.step_comparison_population: paired episodes where both policies succeed
decision_rule.test_reuse: Do not tune on locked-test results; if test outcomes guide new changes, reclassify it as development data and obtain a new test set
